request_json.title: Alder Relay 2.4 normative retry policy
request_json.text: Alder Relay 2.4 normative retry policy, approved 2028-02-04. The default total_attempts value is 1, including the initial attempt. A signed deployment configuration may override total_attempts to an integer from 1 to 4. Only a transport timeout is retryable; HTTP 4xx responses remain final and must not be retried. The deployment value takes precedence over this default. A retry allowance is a ceiling, not evidence that any request actually retried.
